definition: a flat round shape like a plate
description: A frozen lake on a sunny winter day. A large flat round disk of ice has been cut out of the lake and floats in a ring of dark water. A man in an orange puffer jacket, a beanie and mirrored ski goggles pushes it with a long wooden pole so that it turns, then stands up straight holding the pole, while four friends sit on camping chairs on the disk, waving and cheering. An ice saw and a hand drill lie on the snow in front, and pine forest and snowy hills line the shore.

taps.phrase: to push with a long pole
